note: Printed PDFs now carry the Business Unit and an editable letterhead. Project Summary and Gantt PDFs show which BU each project belongs to, and the Gantt is grouped by Business Unit. A new Settings → Report Letterhead lets you upload a company logo (shown on the left of every PDF) and set the address and contact line once, plus the document & version control number separately for each output (Gantt, Project Summary, Daily Meeting) since each is its own controlled form. Nothing changes until you set them — the Gantt keeps its SY3-F-EPD-002 default.
